verdict.rationale: Kong's developer docs (which host Insomnia's docs) expose a working llms.txt endpoint (HTTP 200) that an agent could be pointed at, and Insomnia's docs are also served as machine-readable .md files (e.g. test.md, scripts.md, mcp-clients-in-insomnia.md) confirming agent-oriented doc formatting. This shows the capability works, though it's part of the broader Kong docs site rather than an Insomnia-specific llms.txt, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent actually consuming it. Missing for 10: an Insomnia-specific llms.txt file, and independent evidence of an agent successfully using these docs.
